Q1
filter @message like /"headers"\s*:/
| parse @message /"X-Forwarded-For"\s*:\s*"(?<xff>[^",]+)/
| parse @message /"sourceIp"\s*:\s*"(?<source_ip>[^"]+)"/
| parse @message /"CloudFront-Viewer-Country"\s*:\s*"(?<country>[A-Z]{2})"/
| parse @message /"X-Amz-Cf-Id"\s*:\s*"(?<cf_id>[^"]+)"/
| fields coalesce(xff, source_ip) as src, coalesce(country, "") as cc, ispresent(cf_id) as cf
| stats count(*) as count, min(@timestamp) as first_at, max(@timestamp) as last_at by src, cc, cf
| sort count desc
| limit 10000

Q2
filter @message like /"headers"\s*:/
| parse @message /"X-Forwarded-For"\s*:\s*"(?<xff>[^",]+)/
| parse @message /"sourceIp"\s*:\s*"(?<source_ip>[^"]+)"/
| parse @message /"CloudFront-Viewer-Country"\s*:\s*"(?<country>[A-Z]{2})"/
| parse @message /"X-Amz-Cf-Id"\s*:\s*"(?<cf_id>[^"]+)"/
| fields coalesce(xff, source_ip) as src, coalesce(country, "") as cc, ispresent(cf_id) as cf
| parse @message /"path"\s*:\s*"(?<path>[^"]+)"/
| filter path like /__ADMIN_PATH_REGEX__/
| stats count(*) as count, min(@timestamp) as first_at, max(@timestamp) as last_at by src, path, cc
| sort count desc
| limit 10000

Q3
parse @message /"request_id"\s*:\s*"(?<rid>[^"]+)"/
| parse @message /"statusCode"\s*:\s*"?(?<status>401|403)/
| filter ispresent(rid) and ispresent(status)
| stats count(*) as count, latest(@timestamp) as latest, min(@timestamp) as first_at, max(@timestamp) as last_at by rid, status
| sort latest desc
| limit 10000

Q4
filter @message like /"headers"\s*:/
| parse @message /"X-Forwarded-For"\s*:\s*"(?<xff>[^",]+)/
| parse @message /"sourceIp"\s*:\s*"(?<source_ip>[^"]+)"/
| parse @message /"CloudFront-Viewer-Country"\s*:\s*"(?<country>[A-Z]{2})"/
| parse @message /"X-Amz-Cf-Id"\s*:\s*"(?<cf_id>[^"]+)"/
| fields coalesce(xff, source_ip) as src, coalesce(country, "") as cc, ispresent(cf_id) as cf
| parse @message /"request_id"\s*:\s*"(?<rid>[^"]+)"/
| parse @message /"path"\s*:\s*"(?<path>[^"]+)"/
| filter rid in __REQUEST_IDS__
| stats count(*) as count, min(@timestamp) as first_at, max(@timestamp) as last_at by src, path, cc
| sort count desc
| limit 10000

Q5
filter @message like /受信しました。/
| parse @message /受信しました。\s+(?<method>\S+)\s+(?<path>\S+)\s+(?<src>[^\s"\\]+)/
| filter ispresent(src)
| stats count(*) as count, min(@timestamp) as first_at, max(@timestamp) as last_at by src, method
| sort count desc
| limit 10000
